ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Old Wang of the eastern village burns paper money at night is the recorded answer to what remains at year’s end and to a phrase outside the three vehicles. Later masters repeatedly raise, verse, and answer this same public case.
EvidenceBody: Xianglin’s answer is transmitted in year-end addresses; Shimen gives it for the separate-transmission phrase; Liaotang Weiyi and Tian’an Sheng raise it and add their own verses.
